title: /v/ The Musical VIII
notes:
/v/ the Musical VIII - Overtime Crunch & Social Distancing Edition (Now Exposed by Mudrakers)

Eighth entry of 4chan's /v/ - Video Games forum user collaboration, /v/ the Musical. Contains popular music & scores covers parodying the video game industry and 4chan's culture.

Digital release. All six albums were released on bandcamp, but merely as placeholders to host mega download links that also includes the DLC bonus disc separated into two categories; original songs that were unfinished or disqualified, and alternate recordings and mixes. 

Track formats are FLAC (1, 3 to 9, 11 to 20, 22 to 26, 28 to 36, 38, 39, 41 to 53, 56 to 60, 62 to 67, 69 to 72, 74 to 76, 78 to 83, 85 to 90, 92 to 101, 103 to 106, 109, 111 to 121, 123 to 140, 142, 145, 147, 154, 157, 160, 162 to 165, 167, 170, 171, 173, 175 to 181, 183, 186, 188, 192, 194 to 203, 205, 206, 208, 209), OGG (40, 108), WAV (10, 27, 68, 73, 84, 110, 122, 141, 148, 153, 159, 172, 174, 184, 185, 187, 191, 204, 207, 210), MP3-VBR (21, 37, 61, 77, 91, 102, 107, 150, 152, 161, 166, 169, 189, 190), MP3-320kbps (2, 54, 55, 144, 146, 155, 156, 158, 168, 182, 193), MP3-128kbps (149, 151) & M4A-64kbps (143).
